balls.text: yorker, digs it out, softly enough to long-on to come back for two
makes room, misses a straight delivery, and Gilchrist lets through two leg-byes
slower short one, and beats Bollinger on the attempted flat-bat
looks for the big heave over mid-on in circle, but times it only so well to carry to that very fielder, Symonds
lovely save by Smith at deep midwicket, Thushara connects with this slog powerfully, but Smith comes around and sticks his right hand and saves two
bouncer, and Aswhin makes room and top-edges it to only as far as the pitch's other end and Harris claims the catch - Deccan are finishing this one off well all right
looks for the slog, gets the outer half of the bat on it, and gets a couple to wide of long-off
full toss, but doesn't get power behind the hit, and gets only two to deep midwicket
slower cutter, Ashwin makes room and hits it down to long-off
gets on a knee and hits this length delivery down to long-off for one
looks to cut, and it sneaks under his bat, another dot
full toss on the pads, pushed to deep midwicket for one
goes through him, back of a length, close to off, slight extra bounce
early into the pull shot, gets a leg-bye off the shoulder
low full toss, gets a single to long-off
turned away to fine leg for one

Raina has holed out to long-off, big wicket as he had the responsibility of getting a big score. Sees a length ball, clears front leg and throws his all into it, but it doesn;t hit the sweep part of the bat and Sharma does the rest
Ashwin pulls first ball, and gets it first bounce to deep square leg
finally Badri gets out with his master shot! He tries the scoop again, this time gets a leading edge that lobs to short third
hurries him into the pull shot, gives away just a single off the inside edge onto the pad
short and wide, punched away to deep point for one
behind the wicket is Badri's area, he looks to scoop it over short fine, and this one goes off the back of the bat over short third! Looking London, talking Tokyo
angled into the pads, gets a single to square leg
Raina makes room, RP digs it in short, Raina fails at the attempted late-cut
full delivery, driven to long-off for a single, fifty up for raina - and he ios also close to becoming the highest run-getter in all IPLs
another legbreak, this time he pushes it down to long-off
looks to go down the ground, doesn't make good connection, and gets a single to extra cover
delivered with the legbrak, but it slides with the angle and beats Raina's attempt to steer it to third man
slower ball again, Badri misses again, gets just a leg-bye
legcutter, no room, dabbed back
looks to pull, but it is not short enough and he is beaten
soft dismissal, short and sitting up, but Hussey finds out thethree-quarters deep midwicket to perfection
pushed down to long-on for one
through Raina's legs, firmly hit back and Raina makes way for it through to long-off
makes room, Symonds follows him, he turns it around the corner for one
another big shot from Raina, charges down the track, converts this into a half-volley and lofts it over long-on
swept away powerfully, just to the left of deep square leg, and they come back for two
looks to cut but this is not quite there for the shot, fails to time
shorter ball and pushed to sweeper-cover for one
Raina goes big, Raina goes clean, Raina goes straight, lovely six
premeditates a sweep from outside off, gets just a leg-bye
flat delivery, pushed down to long-on for one
shorter, punched wide of deep midwicket, Raina calls for the second and makes it with his dive
pushed past cover-point for another single
fired into the pads, gets a single to short fine
shorter, flatter, hit to extra cover
comes down the track and drives down to long-off for one
wide down the leg side
looks for the reverse-sweep, fails to connect, but gets a leg-bye
on the pads, and worked away to on for one
flighted outside off, left alone

lovely delivery, fast offbreak, 88.5ks, angling in, making him play, pitching middle and off and then beating him with the break and takes the off stump. Ojha is ecstatic, and he hurts himself during a high-five with Gilly
Dhoni charges at him too, he fires it into his pads and forces a defensive shot
gives him the charge again, Ojha bowls flat, and he pushes it down to long-off
Raina charges down and lofts him between deep square leg and deep midwicket
cramps him up for room as he looks to cut
slower offcutter, cramps him, takes the edge, but is dropped by Gilly. Tough chance but dropped
length ball, pushed down to long-on for one
on the pads, flicked away for one
slower ball, turned to square leg for one
hits a lovely inside-out shot, but the long-off is wide and keeps them to one
short delivery, pulled down the ground for one
gives him the charge and bunts this wide of the bowler for one
slightly shorter, pulled away to wide of sweeper-cover, and comes back for two
flighted around leg, turning away, defended back
comes down the track, and defends it back to the bowler
full ball, pushed down to long-off for one
pushed down to long-off for one
short, wide, hit away to deep point for a single
nips back at him, and cramps him up for room
pushed to long-on for a single
walks down the track and hits a length ball to long-off
yorker, hit back to the bowler on the bounce
full ball outside off, hit back to the bowler

oh what a call from Vijay! He has run himself out, Raina hit it to just to the left of deep midwicket, Vijay called for the second and had barely crossed the halfway mark when the throw came and the bails were removed
slower ball, pushed to wide of extra cover for one
another half-tracker, pulled away to deep midwicket
slower ball again, short and wide but the cut shot finds cover-point
slower ball, almost yorks him, gets a single to long-on
gentle full toss on the pads, and deposited to the deep square leg boundary
slowish delivery, stops on him as he looks for the extra-cover drive
good shot, nearly a yorker, makes room and squeezes it past point for two runs
slower ball, punched away to extra cover
short ball, cut to point, sent back by Vijay
length ball on off, pushed to extra cover
pushes this back-of-a-length delivery to point for one
now some pepper into those wounds, takes a step down the wicket, turns this into a half-volley and flicks it past short fine leg
rubs salt into wounds here, lofting him over mid-on
dropped by Mishra at deep square leg, Raina gets sort of handcuffed as he looks to pull and ends up lobbing it straight to the fielder, but Mishra runs in too far, and then sees it fall over
back of a length, outside off, defended to cover
short and wide, but can't beat the point fieldsman
back of a length, on the pads, played to mid-on
short outside off, left alone

and it's the Mongoose who wilts in the heat and not Harmeet! Hayden looks to run this down to third man, but incredibly Harmeet finds the edge on Mongoose [I was told it didn't have anything but the sweet part], and Gilly holds onto a smart catch
makes room again, but gets an inside edge onto the pad for a single
makes room to hit inside-out, but finds extra cover
crashed away over long-on first ball, just waits in the crease and murders a length ball. Clean golf-like swing
slower through the air, flighted generously, Hayden stays in the crease to defend
pitched shorter, stays in the crease, and hits it back on a half-volley to Sharma
almost yorks himself as he charges down the pitch but gets enough power in it to beat mid-on and got for four
comes down the track and plays the little chip shot wide of long-on
superb shot, makes room and cuts this from way outside leg and cuts it in front of cover-point
slower but still down the leg side, and Vijay has no problems accepting the favour
fired into the pads, worked away for a single
tips and runs to point
full and wide, Hayden leaves that alone, but it has crossed just inside the wide line
short, into the hips, pulled away stylishly, gets a single to fine leg
walks down the track again, almost yorks himself, gets just a single to mid-off
on the pads and he misses out as he is a bit early into the flick
bunted towards mid-on and he is called through for a quick single
goes for another big one outside off, gets the outside half of the bat and it just manages to clear point
goes for another flat-bat, but can't get it past midwicket
flat-batted! violence! length ball, and lofted over long-on. No respect
short ball, pulled to deep square leg for one
poor bowling, length ball on pads with the short fine up, and is flicked past short fine
slower ball, Hayden is early into the attempted big hit, gets only a single to mid-on
walks down the track but this is too wide outside off
swatted down the ground, gets a single to mid-on
left alone outside off
good comeback from the fast bowler, back of a length and extra bounce beating the batsman
Hayden hits his stride early, sends a length ball rocketing over mid-off
back of a lneght, sligh shape, a slight appeal for lbw but it is slipping down
angling into the pads, and flicked away for one to fine leg
guides it to short third man, and Deccan are right back in the semi-finals race
looks to paddle but it turns down the leg side, scores level
on the pads, and placed between deep fine leg and square leg, and comes back for two
length ball, hit straight to extra cover
dabbed away to third man for a single
slower offcutter, but it starts too wide and ends wider
Symonds makes room and hits it powerfully but straight to extra cover
follows the big hit with a bunted single
Maybe not! Smith produces the big hit this time, lovely straight strike again, a mere flick, and it goes over long-on
and Symonds produces the big hit at the right time again. This one misses the yorker length by about a foot, enough for Symonds to get under and loft straight of long-off for four
back of a length, Smith stays deep in the crease and works it for one
lucky Dougy, straying on the pads with short fine up in the circle, but Symonds hits it straight towards Tyagi
yorker again, and again Smith manages a single down to long-off
short, cut away to third man for one
starts off with a yorker, Smith digs it out and gets a single
flatter delivery, hit to straightish extra cover
and now the nurdle into the leg side, and he has places it well to come back for two
another lovely hit from Symonds, no back lift or follow through, dances down the track and hits it flat and straight, lovely six
flicks a full ball for a single
Symonds pushes it to the right of the bowler, Jakati is hampered by the batsman getting back into the none-striker's crease, and a single ensues

had he had precision equipments he couldn't have found Raina at long-off better! This inside-out shot has got him many runs tonight, but this one he ends up hitting far straighter than he wants, and Raina is a touch wide too. All that means the game is not over yet
guided to backward point for one, and Symonds is quick enough to beat the direct hit
slower short ball, and beats his swipe
pulled away, wide of fine leg, comes back for an easy two
back of a length, on the pads, blocked back to the bowler
slower ball, and he runs it down to third man for one
looks to cut this one, but it is too close to him, and he gets a bottom edge
short and way too wide outside off
soft hands as he places this into the leg side and comes back for a couple
stays a touch low, hit straight to short fine
consecutive fifties! Whips this in the air from in front of stumps, and gets it wide of deep square leg
Sumannnn! beautiful shot! Gets a length ball, makes a bit of room and goes over extra cover, and so cleanly has he connected he gets six
Hayden! This is short, sitting up to be hit, but Hayden at midwicket makes a save to his right and prevents any runs
starts with a slower one, beats Suman outside off
full again, Symonds presses forward and defends
flighted around off, blocked back to the bowler
lovely shot! Strong arms and wrists! Hardly a back lift or a follow through here, just merely flicked straight back over his head
short and flat, opens the face late, gets it past short third for two
pushes one down to long-on and takes a single, no runner for him
fullish ball, pushed down to long-off
cut away wide of deep point, and comes back for another couple
nicely placed between fine leg and deep square leg, and comes back for two
chips down the pitch and kicks it out, and claims a leg-bye and is granted! I am not sure he attempted a shot here
turn and bounce, beats him, and the ball lobs off the pad
stays back and turns this to fine leg for one
Suman continues doing well! Flighted on the pads, and he clears the front leg, bends a little, and lofts it over midwicket, sweet hit
regulation offbreak this time, Symonds stays back and blocks it
arm ball, gets Symonds's inside edge onto the pad
pushed wide of extra cover for one
big shout for lbw, but sliding down the leg side as he ends up playing on the off side of the delivery - not straightening enough
nicely chipped over extra cover, finds the gap, that has been his big shot tonight
short and flat, pushed down to wide of long-off
flat and fast, blocked off the back foot
all UP dismissal, short and wide, Sharma cuts, the thick edge flies to the right of short third where Tyagi takes a diving catch
charges down the track, mis-hits to deep square leg for one
nice inside-out chip, comes back for two by the time Bollinger fields from sweeper-cover
driven past cover for one
comes down the track and mis-hits, but it bounces in front of long-on
helped away to long-on for a single
pushed to cover, another dot ball
looks to run this down to third man and ends up playing inside the line
cut away wide enough of deep point to come back for two
back of a length, close to him, pushed to cover
short delivery, cut to deep point for one
turning into the pads, and helped away to fine leg
straighter one, Rohit stays back and defends
stops in his followthrough before releasing, angles it into the pads, concedes a single
good shot, gooood shot, sees a flighted delivery, comes down the track and drives inside-out, past extra cover
presses forward and then goes back to try and late-cut it, but can't beat short third
full delivery, pushed down to long-on for one
punched away to third man for one
short, and outside off, limply upper-cuts it, and it bounces just short of third man
flashes outside off again, and is beaten
another edge gets them four, slightly awkward flash at it outside off, and it flies over slip
back of a length, not much room, played to point
short and wide, cut away to deep point
shorter, stays back, and defends, end of a very useful spell for Chennai
comes forward to block a regulation offbreak
carrom ball, Suman has no clue about this one as it leaves him
turning into the pads, worked around the corner
bowled full again, hit to short cover
full delivery, blocked to mid-on
fullish ball, stays back to hit it to mid-on
runs this one down to short third, won't get a single
shimmies down the track, is not to the pitch of it, and blocks it
manages to cut this time to sweeper-cover
stops at him a touch, and he pushes it to short cover
flat delivery, pushed down to lone-off for one
comes forward to defend this one
big lbw shout first ball, the offbreak beats him as his bat is hidden behind the pad, but Taufel reckons it might just me turning too far down the leg side

nice stumping from MSD! Not a dull moment around with Deccan! Looks to make room to go inside-out, Ashwin follows him with a loopy offbreak, beats him comprehensively, and Dhoni drags this from way outside leg and whips the bails off before the overbalanced Mishra can get back in
into the pads, helped away past the backward square leg and comes back for three
turn and bounce, into the pads, beats him
what a beauty from Ashwin, angling in, pitching middle and off, Gilchrist looks to run it down but it breaks away and takes a faint tickle through
quick, just about off line, pushed to short cover
comes down the track again and throws everything at it and is beaten
Mishra is running away, picks the slower ball early and lofts it over midwicket for six
comes down the track and flashes at it, but the edge flies between keeper and wide slip
and he has disdainfully dismissed this one, length ball outside off, and hit powerfully on the up, to the right of mid-off
slower ball, hit down to mid-on for one
sharp bouncer, 141ks, Gilchrist sways out of the line, and slightly harshly it is called wide for height
tunred away to fine leg, sent back by Gilly, and he just about beats the under-arm flick by half a frame
fired too far down the leg side
gets an inside edge as he looks to cut
dropped by Hayden at slip, this was the quicker delivery, and the edge flew past keeper, and Hayden couldn't his right hand around in time
shorter delivery, can't get it past point
big appeal for lbw, they reckon it is pad first, but it is clearly bat as Gilchrist defends this one
is beaten in the flight as he charges down, but manages a leg-bye
short, slightly outside off, opens the face on it, hits it straight to point
his response is to give the bowler the charge, gets a single off the bottom edge
hit in the helmet! Lovely bouncer, 136.1kph, is clearly late into the shot, but he is fine and doesn't show any pain or concern
gets a thick outside edge on this attempted big shot, and it is worth two runs to fine of third man
short, slightly wide, cut away to third man for one
looks for the pull, but it slides too far down the leg side
hurries him in with a full ball, Mishra gets a single to mid-off
comes down the track, gets the outside half of the bat for a single to extra cover
makes room, he fires it into his pads, no run
comes down the track, plays inside-out, and places it past mid-off
into the pads, can't get it past square leg
stops on him, the check shot lands just in front of Ashwin
starts with his carrom ball, the straighter ball that takes the leading edge
